steps.title: A confident answer is a different artifact
steps.objective: Compare authored model output with an actual symbolic decision.

steps.title: Who will maintain the knowledge?

steps.title: Repair an assurance claim
steps.objective: Replace an unconditional promise with a scoped, testable assurance statement.

steps.title: A name is not an existential
steps.objective: Distinguish a fixed description from a quantified requirement.

steps.title: A statement inside a statement

steps.title: One person must satisfy both clauses
steps.objective: Distinguish one shared answer from two independent answers.

steps.objective: Count distinct answer bindings under accepted equality.

steps.title: A count is a question, not inventory
steps.objective: Keep exact-count checks out of asserted evidence.

steps.title: Empty is different from zero

steps.title: Withhold an unfinished total
steps.objective: Distinguish a complete empty answer from a refused incomplete collection.

steps.title: A denial has its own source
steps.objective: Distinguish a negative source assertion from a negative query succeeding by absence.

steps.title: Repair a circular default
steps.objective: Inspect and repair an unstratifiable negative dependency.

steps.title: A plausible name is not a predicate
steps.objective: Repair vocabulary and place-signature errors at the compiler boundary.

lessons.title: Changing knowledge without losing the record

steps.title: Try a correction in a candidate world
steps.objective: Keep hypothetical evidence separate until its reviewed delta is admitted.

steps.title: A profile belongs to the result

steps.title: Recover a project, preserve an investigation

steps.title: A single inspection is not a universal policy
steps.objective: Replace an overbroad rule with the single approval supported by its source.

steps.title: An explicit negative needs its own source

steps.title: Routing does not declare a vocabulary

steps.title: One query can reuse a backend reply

steps.title: A model-backed check is still an external assumption

steps.title: Promote a reviewed observation deliberately

lessons.title: Choose, bound and measure a runtime

steps.title: Inspect the artifact you actually run

steps.title: Locate the budget that stopped work

steps.title: Recover after a real fuel trap
steps.objective: Recover committed inputs after an actual WASI fuel trap.

steps.title: A memory cap is not process RSS
steps.objective: Interpret component growth limits and recover after a memory trap.

steps.title: Reopen without renumbering evidence
steps.objective: Preserve source identities across deletion, reopening and later withdrawal.

steps.title: Measure the work you named
steps.objective: Measure distinct engine phases and distinguish allocations from resident memory.

steps.title: Budget for review and maintenance as well as inference
steps.objective: Estimate integration costs with explicit workload and staffing assumptions.

lessons.title: Build an application around retained evidence

steps.objective: Trace application records through explicit admission into engine sources.

steps.title: The same cart can belong to different cases

steps.objective: Connect actual proof citations to source IDs and application provenance.

steps.title: Separate an agent proposal from an authorized action

steps.title: Rebuild a scoped evidence workflow
